entities.summary: Preetinder Singh Bharara is an Indian-born American attorney and former federal prosecutor who served as the U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York from 2009 to 2017. As of 2025, he is a partner at the WilmerHale law firm. Preet Bharara was a legal figures from Firozpur (b. 1968-10-13, Firozpur). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
